column1: # CP13B future-mode expectations on the integrated runtime-2 baseline.
#   vm                genuine VM execution (vm_executions = 1), program completes
#   vm-error          genuine VM execution, program error (exit 1)
#   fallback:<reason> the VM refuses the unit statically while legacy EXECUTES
#                     it (a run-time or compile diagnostic in legacy). The exact
#                     VM refusal reason is pinned; vm_executions = 0 and the
#   limit             an uncatchable resource-limit stop (D7), proved from the
#                     outcome, exit, diagnostic and heap statistics.
# policies: comma-separated short ids mapped to vm_policies.POLICIES:
# Nothing else is an approved difference.
# env: optional `NAME=VALUE;NAME=VALUE` applied only to the VM run.
# checks: `uncatchable` requires catchable=false; `cp16` marks a fixture that
#   needs CP16 integration (expected incomplete before then).
